baselineDisplay.title: Poor Ian
baselineDisplay.question: Who wanted to sell the house?
baselineDisplay.text:
Who wanted to sell the house?

Has Ian sold his house yet?
Yes, he has.
He sold it last week.
Has he moved to his new house yet?
No, not yet.
He's still here.
He's going to move tomorrow.
When? Tomorrow morning?
No. Tomorrow afternoon.
I'll miss him.
He has always been a good neighbour.
He's a very nice person.
We'll all miss him.
When will the new people move into this house?
I think that they'll move in the day after tomorrow.
Will you see Ian today, Jenny?
Yes, I will.
Please give him my regards.
Poor Ian! He didn't want to leave this house.
No, he didn't want to leave, but his wife did!

baselineDisplay.bodyTextZh:
伊恩已经卖掉他的房子了吗？
是的，他已经卖了。
他上周把它卖掉了。
他已经搬进新房子了吗？
不，还没有。
他还在这里。
他明天就要搬家了。
什么时候？明天早上吗？
不，明天下午。
我会想念他的。
他一直是个很好的邻居。
他是个非常友善的人。
我们都会想念他的。
新搬来的人什么时候会入住这栋房子呢？
我认为他们会在后天搬进来。
珍妮，你今天会见到伊恩吗？
是的，我会的。
请代我向他问好。
可怜的伊恩！他根本不想离开这栋房子。
不，他不想离开，但他妻子想！

notes: 通读20句搬家对话与中译，核对上周售房、明天下午搬走、后天新住户搬入和真正想卖房的是妻子。保留yet/still、问候语与英式neighbour，句序和时间段完整；只规范课号空格。
